headline: Sonny Gray shuts down the Phillies at Fenway while the schedule release looms
morning_brew: Finally, a win at Fenway Park that did not feel like pulling teeth. Sonny Gray was outstanding on Wednesday, giving us six strong innings and allowing only one run. It is basic fundamentals: you throw strikes and you give your team a chance to win. Wilyer Abreu had three hits, which is exactly the kind of production this lineup has been missing during this tough stretch. Aroldis Chapman made it interesting with those two walks in the ninth, but three strikeouts slammed the door for the save. An eighteen and twenty-four record is still not where we want to be, but beating a good Phillies team is a start.

News broke about rookie linebacker Quintayvious Hutchins pleading not guilty to a domestic assault charge. This is a tough situation and I hope everyone involved is safe. We have to let the league and the legal system handle the process here. If the league decides to hand down discipline later on, we will deal with the on-field impact then. For now, the team has to stay focused on the work in front of them as the transition to the professional level continues.

Today is the day we finally get the full schedule and can start planning our lives around the fall. I am looking for those divisional games and seeing if we have to fly across the ocean again. Meanwhile, the Garden is quiet with the B's and C's both in the offseason after those early exits. We are looking at a long summer of roster moves and draft talk, but that is the price you pay for not getting the job done in May.

news_digest.dans_take: I just want to know when we play the Jets so I can book my seat.

news_digest.dans_take: Tough news for the Collins family, our thoughts are with them during this time.
